scripts.dev:backend: npm run build:backend && concurrently -k -n compile,server "tsc -p backend/tsconfig.json --watch" "node --watch backend/dist/main.js"
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:backend && npm run typecheck:frontend
scripts.test: npm run build:backend && node --test tests/unit/auth-service.test.mjs tests/unit/password-hasher.test.mjs tests/unit/user-repository.test.mjs tests/integration/health.test.mjs tests/integration/auth.test.mjs tests/integration/chat.test.mjs
